title: ClusterValues
description: Per-cluster values file (bootstrap/values/cluster-values.yaml) consumed by the Harness Hg Helm chart.

providers.description: Which backend implements each concern for this cluster. Environment-level decisions: a profile record cannot change a provider.

compute.description: Compute backend for agent workloads. pod - the chart's StatefulSet - is the only compute path (hermes.computeGuard).

secret.description: Secret backend. k8s materializes secrets via ExternalSecrets reading the in-cluster ClusterSecretStore; configured under secretBackend.k8s.

ingress.description: Ingress backend for exposed services: ingress (standard Ingress resources), cloudflare (a Cloudflare Tunnel per instance), or none. tailscale is retired - this frozen schema still accepts it, but the chart's own values schema refuses it at render time.

backup.description: Which backend implements spec.backup intent. pvc archives the instance's data volume into a per-instance backups PVC on the declared schedule; none means the platform offers no backup destination and a profile declaring spec.backup fails the render loudly (hermes.backupGuard).

image.description: The Hermes agent container image, used by both the bootstrap initContainer and the main container. A record's spec.deployment.baseImageTag, when set, overrides image.tag.

repository.description: Image repository for the Hermes agent container.

tag.description: Image tag for the Hermes agent container; overridden per instance by spec.deployment.baseImageTag.

platformRepo.description: The platform (factory-level/harness-hg) repo + revision Argo CD renders the hermes-profile chart from - the profiles ApplicationSet's chart source, threaded here so the chart can reuse it as the Application source for spec.apps[] entries with repo: local (local charts ship inside the platform repo and version with it). Scaffolded as the __HERMES_GITOPS_REPO_URL__/__CHART_REVISION__ tokens.

url.description: Git URL of the platform repository the chart is rendered from. Scaffolded as the __HERMES_GITOPS_REPO_URL__ token.

revision.description: Git revision (branch, tag or commit) the chart is rendered at. Scaffolded as the __CHART_REVISION__ token.

appProject.description: Argo CD AppProject configuration for the per-app child Applications the hermes-profile chart renders (one per spec.apps[] entry). sourceRepos is the platform's remote helm repo allowlist: a profile's spec.apps[].repo must appear here (render fails loudly otherwise - hermes.appsGuard); the scaffold renders this list into the sourceRepos of the GitOps repo's bootstrap/project.yaml (the server-side enforcement of the same allowlist) on every reconcile, twinning each oci:// entry with its scheme-less form. repo: local is always allowed and needs no entry.

name.description: Name of the Argo CD AppProject the per-app child Applications are created in.

sourceRepos.description: Remote Helm repositories (https:// or oci://) profiles may pull spec.apps[] charts from. Declared once here; the scaffold renders them into bootstrap/project.yaml's sourceRepos in the GitOps repo (oci:// entries twinned scheme-less). repo: local needs no entry.

secretBackend.description: Per-provider secret backend configuration; keys correspond to providers.secret values.

namespace.description: Namespace the seeded source Secrets live in. Carried for schema parity - the chart itself does not read it; the cluster-scoped ClusterSecretStore pins its own remoteNamespace server-side.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare Tunnel ingress configuration (providers.ingress: cloudflare) - consumed by the chart's tunnel Stack CR templates and validated by hermes.cloudflareConfigGuard. Optional; required keys within it are enforced by the guard only when the cloudflare ingress provider is selected.

accountId.description: Cloudflare account every hermes-<name>-tunnel Stack provisions its tunnel, DNS and Access resources under. No safe default - the guard fails the render when unset under the cloudflare provider.

zoneId.description: ID of the Cloudflare zone tunnel DNS records are created in. Required by the guard when providers.ingress is cloudflare.

zoneName.description: Name of the Cloudflare zone (the public domain) tunnel hostnames live under. Required by the guard when providers.ingress is cloudflare.

cloudflaredImage.description: The cloudflared sidecar image run beside the agent container under the cloudflare ingress provider.

repository.description: Image repository for the cloudflared sidecar.

tag.description: Image tag for the cloudflared sidecar.

access.description: Cloudflare Access configuration for instances whose expose access policy is idp or mixed.

idpId.description: ID of an existing Cloudflare Access identity-provider integration, created out of band in the Zero Trust dashboard - never created here. Needed only when an installed instance's access policy is idp or mixed; may stay empty for a fleet that only uses service tokens.

apiToken.description: The Cloudflare API token the tunnel Stack workspaces authenticate to the Cloudflare API with - a fleet-wide shared secret, referenced by key, never by value.

remoteSecretKey.description: Key in the remote secret backend holding the shared Cloudflare API token; every instance's ExternalSecret reads the same key (seed once, read everywhere).

tunnel.description: Git identity and workspace settings for the cloudflare-tunnel Pulumi program the rendered tunnel Stack CRs point at.

projectRepo.description: Git URL of the repository holding the cloudflare-tunnel Pulumi program. Defaults to the platform repository itself - override only if you vendor the program elsewhere.

commit.description: Commit the tunnel program is pinned at. Takes precedence over branch when both are set (mutually exclusive on the Stack CRD).

branch.description: Branch the tunnel program tracks when no commit is pinned.

workspaceServiceAccountName.description: Kubernetes ServiceAccount the tunnel Stack's workspace pod runs as. Expected to already exist with Cloudflare API credentials and, for providers.secret k8s, RBAC to write Secrets - the chart creates neither. Empty defaults to the instance's own pod ServiceAccount.

pulumiBackend.description: Pulumi state backend for the tunnel Stack workspaces, config-switched between Pulumi Cloud and a self-managed backend.

mode.description: Which backend shape is active: pulumi-cloud (a PULUMI_ACCESS_TOKEN Secret) or self-managed (a backend URL plus a passphrase Secret).

remoteSecretKey.description: Key in the remote secret backend holding the shared PULUMI_ACCESS_TOKEN.

backendUrl.description: Pulumi state backend URL, rendered as PULUMI_BACKEND_URL on the tunnel workspace.

remotePassphraseKey.description: Key in the remote secret backend holding the shared Pulumi state passphrase.

tailscale.description: Tailscale ingress configuration (providers.ingress: tailscale) - consumed by the chart's tailscale sidecar + ExternalSecret templates and validated by hermes.tailscaleConfigGuard. Optional; required keys within it are enforced by the guard only when the tailscale ingress provider is selected.

authKey.description: The Tailscale auth key the sidecar joins the tailnet with - referenced by remote key, never by value.

remoteSecretKey.description: Key in the remote secret backend holding the shared Tailscale auth key.

tailscaleImage.description: The tailscale sidecar image run beside the agent container under the tailscale ingress provider.

repository.description: Image repository for the tailscale sidecar.

tag.description: Image tag for the tailscale sidecar.

backup.description: Platform-side configuration for the providers.backup pvc destination. The profile record only declares intent (spec.backup schedule and retention); everything here is a cluster concern.

image.description: Image the archive CronJob runs (tar and sh are all it needs).

repository.description: Image repository for the backup CronJob.

tag.description: Image tag for the backup CronJob.

pvc.description: The per-instance backups PVC (hermes-<name>-backups) archives are written to.

size.description: Requested capacity of the backups PVC, as a Kubernetes quantity (e.g. 5Gi).

storageClassName.description: StorageClass of the backups PVC. Unset uses the cluster default StorageClass.
